use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Holder {
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
    pub tag_template: Option<String>,
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[allow(clippy::disallowed_names)]
mod gapped_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn an_attribute_between_the_gate_and_the_mod_keeps_the_region() {
        let h = Holder::default();
        let _gapped_binary = h.metadata.get("binary");
        let _gapped_family = h.tag_template.clone();
    }
}
